sonicIdentity: Warm, playful, organic, spacious and recognisably KORA KIDS without flattening Africa into one sound.
rules: All score melodies must be original.
No interpolation or close imitation of existing children's themes.
The KORA brand may use a kora-instrument motif, but metadata must correctly identify the kora as a West African instrument rather than a pan-African generic.
Episode-local instruments or musical styles require regional cultural review before final use.
Dialogue clarity always takes priority over music.

signature: short original kora-style plucked motif used as KORA brand punctuation

theme.hookShape: four-note rising question answered by a three-note falling smile
theme.lyricsPolicy: No final lyrics until multilingual singability review. Instrumental theme is the launch default.
